response.sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.ALP * 1.0 / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory x WHERE x.ID = l.ID AND x.`U-PRO` = '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM per_patient GROUP BY SEX
